goal: Add Chinese-localized provider rejection detection for prompt_cache_key and reasoning protocol errors, with strict regression tests and exact model-scoped opt-out validation

summary.title: 补齐中文 provider 拒绝信号识别并精确关闭 GLM 缓存 key
summary.what: 为 prompt_cache_key 字段拒绝与 thinking→reasoning_effort 协议拒绝增加严格的中文匹配，补充正反向及精确模型确认流程测试，并更新 README 与 frontend spec。随后通过确认式 fix 命令，仅为 jiyuanlvdong/glm-5.3-flash 添加 promptCacheKey.omit；新进程验证两种 key 拼法均被移除。
summary.why: 第三方 openai-completions endpoint 返回中文 UNKNOWN_FIELD 错误时，原有英文语法未记录拒绝证据，导致模型级修复无法提出。中文识别补齐证据路径，同时维持条件/值错误不误判、响应 hook 不改配置及修复需要用户预览确认的安全边界。
summary.user_goal: Add Chinese-localized provider rejection detection for prompt_cache_key and reasoning protocol errors, with strict regression tests and exact model-scoped opt-out validation

decisions.chose: 仅当明确拒绝词、字段/参数名、冒号、目标 key 和终止边界按序关联时匹配；值校验失败及条件限制不作为字段不支持证据。
decisions.rationale: 保持与英文 matcher 相同的精确度，避免因错误文本碰巧提到 key 而触发模型级修复。

decisions.chose: 同一诊断字符串必须明确拒绝 thinking 并正向建议 reasoning_effort；分散在不同 header、反向拒绝或否定建议都不匹配。

decisions.point: 缓存 key 修复的作用范围
decisions.chose: 仅为已确认拒绝的 jiyuanlvdong/glm-5.3-flash 写入精确 omit 规则；继续要求交互预览和确认，不在 response hook 中自动修改配置。

review_notes: npm run check 通过：179/179 tests、typecheck、diff check、26 个 source modules 无循环、31 个打包文件检查；task.py validate 和 Mainline preflight 也通过。
用户级 version-2 配置保留 footerMode=session 和文件模式；修复回执与备份 hash 匹配。已运行的旧 Pi 会话仍需 /reload 或重启。
此 Mainline fingerprint 按 a840255 分支基点生成，包含当前任务之前已提交的 Pi 1.0.3 基线/归档路径；本任务实现单独位于提交 b9c3ee8。origin/master 同步只增加无内容差异的 merge commit e93fb24。

architectural_claims: Localized rejection matchers contribute only process-local, exact provider/model evidence; they do not mutate requests or configuration.
The prompt-cache-key repair remains user-invoked and confirmation-gated; an omit rule removes both supported key spellings for only its exact provider/model.
behavioral_changes: Recognize the observed Chinese 400 UNKNOWN_FIELD message for prompt_cache_key and eligible Chinese thinking-to-reasoning_effort rejection signals.
Apply a persisted prompt-cache-key opt-out only to jiyuanlvdong/glm-5.3-flash; unrelated models and payload fields remain unchanged.
security_implications: No raw provider error or trace id is persisted by the matcher; evidence remains process-local and exact-model scoped. The user config change was made via the confirmation flow with receipt/backup integrity verified; no credential values were added to the repository.
migration_notes: The existing version-2 config schema remains valid. Restart Pi or run /reload in sessions that loaded the module before the omit rule was written.
